title: Bimodal Whole-Mount Imaging of Tendon Using Confocal Microscopy and X-ray Micro-Computed Tomography
author: Marr, Hopkinson, et al.

steps.title: Collect and fix tendon samples
steps.instruction: Harvest tendons, wash, fix, and store them under specified conditions before further processing.

substeps.instruction: Collect Achilles tendons from female Wistar rats (13 weeks old, n = 2).
Wash rat tendons in Dulbecco’s phosphate‑buffered saline (DPBS).
Fix rat tendons in 4 % paraformaldehyde for 24 h at room temperature (RT).
Store fixed rat tendons in PBS containing 0.05 % (w/v) sodium azide at 4 °C until further processing.
Collect forelimb superficial digital flexor tendons (SDFT) from female horses (n = 2, ages 7 and 23 years).
Isolate ~5 mm × 5 mm × 2 mm pieces from the mid‑metacarpal region.
Wash horse tendon pieces briefly in DPBS supplemented with 1 % (v/v) antibiotic‑antimycotic solution.
Fix horse tendon pieces in a mixture of 4 % paraformaldehyde and 10 % neutral‑buffered formalin for 24 h at RT.
Store fixed horse tendon pieces in 70 % ethanol at 4 °C until processing.

steps.title: Wash and permeabilise samples
steps.instruction: Perform extensive washes and sequential methanol‑based permeabilisation of the tendon specimens.

substeps.instruction: Place equine SDFT segments on an orbital shaker set to 60 RPM.
Wash SDFT segments twice with tris‑buffered saline (TBS) for 12 h each at RT.
Permeabilise SDFT sequentially at 4 °C:
• 50 % (v/v) methanol : TBS for 2 h,
• 80 % (v/v) methanol : dH₂O for 2 h,
• 100 % methanol for 2 h.
Wash SDFT samples at 4 °C for 40 min each with the following solutions in order:
• 20 % (v/v) dimethyl sulphoxide (DMSO) : methanol,
• 80 % (v/v) methanol : dH₂O,
• 50 % (v/v) methanol : TBS,
• TBS,
• TBS supplemented with 0.2 % (v/v) Triton X‑100 (0.2 % TBS‑TX100).
For rat Achilles tendons, repeat the same wash and permeabilisation sequence but substitute DPBS for TBS in all steps.

steps.title: Pre‑block and block samples
steps.instruction: Incubate samples in a penetration buffer, then block non‑specific binding sites with serum‑containing buffers.

substeps.instruction: Incubate all samples in pre‑blocking penetration buffer (0.2 % TBS‑TX100, 0.3 M glycine, 20 % DMSO) for 6 h at 37 °C with orbital agitation at 60 RPM.
Block equine SDFT segments for 80 h at 37 °C in 0.2 % TBS‑TX100 supplemented with 6 % (v/v) goat serum, 6 % (v/v) donkey serum, and 10 % (v/v) DMSO; keep on orbital shaker at 60 RPM.
Block rat Achilles tendons for 80 h at 37 °C in 0.2 % TBS‑TX100 supplemented with 6 % (v/v) goat serum and 10 % (v/v) DMSO; keep on orbital shaker at 60 RPM.

steps.title: Incubate with primary antibody
steps.instruction: Apply rabbit anti‑LAMA4 primary antibody under defined conditions for each species.

substeps.instruction: Prepare antibody buffer: TBS + 0.2 % (v/v) Tween‑20, 3 % (v/v) goat serum, 3 % (v/v) donkey serum, 5 % (v/v) DMSO (omit donkey serum for rat samples).
Dilute rabbit anti‑LAMA4 (STJ93891, St. John’s Laboratories) 1:200 in antibody buffer for equine SDFT and 1:100 for rat Achilles.
Incubate samples at 37 °C for 80 h with orbital agitation at 60 RPM.

steps.title: Secondary antibody staining and washes
steps.instruction: Wash samples, apply secondary antibody, perform post‑staining washes and DAPI counterstaining.

substeps.instruction: Wash samples three times, 2 h each, in wash buffer (TBS‑Tween‑20) with orbital agitation at 60 RPM.
Prepare secondary antibody solution: goat anti‑rabbit Alexa Fluor® 594 (A11037, Fisher Scientific) diluted 1:250 in antibody buffer for equine SDFT and 1:500 for rat Achilles.
Incubate equine SDFT samples for 36 h and rat Achilles samples for 72 h at 37 °C with orbital agitation at 60 RPM.
Wash samples five times, at least 5 min each, with wash buffer.
Perform an overnight wash in wash buffer containing DAPI (1:2000) for nuclear counterstaining.

steps.title: Dehydrate and clarify tissue
steps.instruction: Dehydrate samples through graded methanol series and clear them using Visikol reagents.

substeps.instruction: Dehydrate samples through increasing concentrations of methanol as described in the permeabilisation section.
Immerse samples in Visikol HISTO‑1:
• 36 h for equine SDFT,
• 72 h for rat Achilles,
at room temperature (RT).
Transfer samples to Visikol HISTO‑2 for at least 36 h at RT.

steps.title: Store clarified samples before imaging
steps.instruction: Keep clarified specimens in HISTO‑2 at 4 °C until confocal microscopy.

substeps.instruction: Place samples in HISTO‑2 and store at 4 °C.

steps.title: 3D image reconstruction and analysis
steps.instruction: Acquire micro‑CT data, reconstruct volumes, and quantify interfascicular matrix (IFM) parameters using dedicated software.

substeps.instruction: Acquire 3‑D images of the clarified tendon plugs.
Define a cylindrical volume‑of‑interest (VOI) of 1.75 mm × 1.75 mm × 2 mm on each sample to avoid damaged regions.
Reconstruct images in CTAn (version 1.17.7.1).
Measure tendon volume (TV), IFM volume (IV), IV/TV ratio, and IFM thickness (IFM.Th) using adapted bone‑analysis workflows (Table 1).
Generate 3‑D colour maps of IFM thickness by adapting BV and Tb.th as proxies for IFM volume and thickness.
Visualise colour‑coded reconstructions in CTVox (version 3.3.0).
Create graphs of the quantitative data in GraphPad Prism (version 8.0.0).
